sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully targets ship-owned properties, uses the required calculation-case relationship and positive-shear controlled value, enforces the stated inclusive position intervals and exact Cf values, validates all quantity datatypes and units, and checks FI = Cf × FIB with the necessary MN-to-kN conversion and expected-result-scaled tolerance.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Do not apply gen:I2_051_PositiveShearCaseShape as sh:node on every nltl:hasCalculationCase value: its sh:hasValue nltl:positiveShearForce makes all calculation cases positive, incorrectly rejecting non-positive cases. Replace it with a generic calculation-case evidence shape that requires the applicable direction and position evidence without forcing positive direction; retain the positive-shear condition exclusively in the bounded SPARQL constraint, so only cases explicitly selected as nltl:positiveShearForce are checked against the 0.0/1.0 longitudinal-factor intervals.

Candidate faithfully targets ship-owned properties, uses the required calculation-case relationship and positive-shear controlled value, enforces the stated inclusive position intervals and exact Cf values, validates all quantity datatypes and units, and checks FI = Cf × FIB with the necessary MN-to-kN conversion and expected-result-scaled tolerance.
